name: Production sampler regression
purpose: Preserve canonical Moon sampled output after LOS/record-format corrections.
production_capability: Full canonical test_Moon build/run and output comparison.
configuration: Canonical test_Moon configuration and registered processor count.
independent_reference: Reviewed external regression reference, used only because no first-principles oracle covers the complete sampled file.
procedure: Run make -j test_Moon and inspect test_Moon.diff.
acceptance_criteria: test_Moon.diff exists and is exactly zero bytes.
status_semantics: PASS is regression agreement; missing reference/build output is ERROR, not SKIPPED or PASS.
